capabilities: Panel, IV, system regression and covariance estimators
limitation: Do not infer dynamic-panel GMM support from the panel-regression label
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.input: Panel or IV/system regression data with explicit formula, effects, instruments and covariance choice.
scientific_qualification.output: Linear model coefficients, residuals and model-specific covariance/diagnostics.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: Strict exogeneity or stated IV moments; rank and dependence assumptions appropriate to each estimator.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Keep fixed effects, instrument sets and covariance axes explicit. The panel label does not establish dynamic-panel GMM support or a modern staggered-adoption ATT.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Compare within and IV estimates to direct projections on a small full-rank design, then use a lagged-outcome short panel to expose invalid strict-exogeneity routing.

evidence.finding: PanelOLS, first differences, IV2SLS/LIML/GMM and systems feature/usage descriptions.
